title: UK’s Eastern Airways suspends operations with all flights cancelled
summary: Customers urged not to go to domestic airline’s airports as customers and staff offered train travel on suitable routes The UK domestic airline Eastern Airways has suspended operations and all of its flights have been cancelled. Customers of the airline, which operated regional services from airports across the UK, are urged not to go to the airport as flights will not be operating, the UK Civil Aviation Authority said.
